qs.q: A patient with a C5 radiculopathy reports numbness in the lateral shoulder. Which dermatome corresponds to this specific sensory deficit?
o: Sensation over the lateral arm and thumb supplied by C6
Sensation over the lateral shoulder supplied by C5
Sensation over the middle finger and forearm supplied by C7
Sensation over the medial fingers and hand supplied by C8
Sensation over the medial arm and axilla supplied by T1
qs.e: C5 dermatomes specifically supply sensation to the lateral shoulder, distinguishing them from adjacent cervical levels.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: Anatomy Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

The T1 dermatome covering the medial forearm and axilla
qs.e: C6 dermatomes specifically supply sensation to the lateral arm and thumb.

qs.q: A patient with a C5 radiculopathy reports weakness in shoulder abduction. Which muscle is primarily affected?
o: The deltoid muscle innervated by the axillary nerve
The supraspinatus muscle innervated by the suprascapular
The infraspinatus muscle innervated by the suprascapular
The teres minor muscle innervated by the axillary nerve
The biceps brachii muscle innervated by the musculocutaneous
qs.e: C5 radiculopathy affects the deltoid and supraspinatus, key abductors of the shoulder.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: Anatomy Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: A patient with a C6 radiculopathy reports weakness in wrist extension. Which muscle is primarily affected?
o: The flexor carpi ulnaris muscle innervated by the ulnar
The flexor carpi radialis muscle innervated by the median
The extensor carpi ulnaris muscle innervated by the radial
The extensor carpi radialis longus innervated by radial
The brachioradialis muscle innervated by the radial nerve
qs.e: C6 radiculopathy affects wrist extensors like the extensor carpi radialis longus.
qs.s: Weekly Year 1: Anatomy Exam - November 20, 2026 (Section A: MCQs)

qs.q: A patient with a C7 radiculopathy reports weakness in elbow extension. Which muscle is primarily affected?

The brachialis muscle innervated by the musculocutaneous
The anconeus muscle innervated by the radial nerve
The supinator muscle innervated by the posterior radial
qs.e: C7 radiculopathy affects the triceps brachii, the primary elbow extensor.
